title: Uniform stationary Aldous tightness for local PAH observables
question: Do the unchanged finite stationary PAH processes give a uniform compact-time Aldous modulus for every bounded local cylinder observable, using only the registered C_sw and C2 bounds?
purpose: Close the path-compactness subgate without constructing a new process, comparison map, carrier or rate. The result is an input to a later martingale-problem and target-identification proof, not that proof itself.

exact_scope.finite_processes: For every finite PAH-OMC-004 strip level n>=2 and positive radial cutoff R, use the original finite continuous-time Markov chain with generator L_(n,R), labelled Gibbs stationary law pi_(n,R), and no terminal conditioning.
exact_scope.observable: A fixed bounded gauge- and anchor-automorphism-invariant local cylinder f with finite root support A and root increment suprema d_r=||f(r dot)-f||_infinity.
exact_scope.constants: Use the source-owned R-490 C_sw=540 interaction envelope and R-522 C2(A)<=60|A| squared-rate bound only as domination inputs.
exact_scope.decomposition: For a stopping time tau<=T and 0<=delta, write f(X_(tau+delta))-f(X_tau)=M_(tau,delta)+D_(tau,delta), where M is the generator martingale increment and D is the time-integrated drift.
exact_scope.target_bound: E|f(X_(tau+delta))-f(X_tau)|^2 <= 2 delta K_Gamma(f)+2 delta^2 K_L(f), uniformly in n,R and tau<=T.
exact_scope.derived_constants: K_Gamma(f)=540 |A| max_r d_r^2 and K_L(f)=60 |A| sum_r d_r^2 are conservative source-derived bounds; any finite support with zero increments gives zero constants.
exact_scope.tightness: The Markov inequality bound [2 delta K_Gamma(f)+2 delta^2 K_L(f)]/epsilon^2 tends to zero as delta->0, giving Aldous tightness of the real-valued local-observable paths in D([0,T],R). Finite vectors follow componentwise.
exact_scope.boundary: This is finite-process path compactness only. It does not identify a subsequential limit, a martingale problem, a common Hilbert space, an infinite-volume process or the R-512 semigroup.

proof_obligations: Revalidate the exact PAH-001, C_sw, C2, pathspace and preregistration hashes.
Derive the carré-du-champ bound from the weighted conductance envelope and the finite local root support.
Derive the drift L2 bound from the registered C2(A) estimate and the same root increments.
Apply the martingale decomposition, optional stopping and the two-square inequality to obtain the compact-time increment envelope.
Show the envelope is uniform in n,R and vanishes with delta, while preserving the external stochastic-time firewall.
Keep martingale-problem identification, uniqueness, N2b/N2c/N4 and R-512 minimal-form selection explicitly open.

acceptance.primary: Exact rational derivation of K_Gamma, K_L and the two-square compact-time envelope for arbitrary support size and increment list, with source hashes and self-tests.
acceptance.independent: Non-importing reconstruction of the conductance, squared-rate, stopping-time and Markov bounds with a different rational fixture.
acceptance.hostile: Reject missing martingale term, missing factor 2, delta-independent bounds, C_sw-as-C2 substitution, fixed-n-only promotion, physical-time relabelling and claims of semigroup convergence.
acceptance.lean: Compile finite algebraic declarations for the two-square inequality, nonnegative envelope, Markov bound and delta decrease; no stochastic-process theorem is formalized.

outcomes.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: Only if the uniform path bound, a source-authorized limit process and the remaining target-identification fields are all independently proved; this contract alone cannot produce that verdict.
outcomes.NEGATIVE_RESULT: An exact PAH finite family violates the derived uniform path envelope or its source assumptions, with the failure separated from target semigroup convergence.
outcomes.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: Use when the local path envelope is verified but process identification, uniqueness, N2b/N2c/N4 or R-512 selection remains absent.

single_next_question: Can a source-authorized martingale-problem construction identify every subsequential local path limit from this tight family with the R-512 minimal-form semigroup, without changing PAH-001?
non_claims: No new finite carrier, functional, rate, state, regulator, normalization, time convention or limit order.
No construction or uniqueness of an infinite-volume process, no martingale-problem identification, and no semigroup convergence.
No common H/U_n, N2b liminf/recovery, N2c/N4 boundary escape or R-512 minimal-form selection.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, mass-gap, Yang-Mills or TOE conclusion.
